data.label: exam-platform-prod-nat-us-east-1a (+ EIP)
data.notes: One NAT per AZ so AZ-A keeps outbound access if AZ-B fails. Used for Secrets Manager / AWS APIs without a VPC endpoint.

data.label: exam-platform-prod-nat-us-east-1b (+ EIP)
data.notes: One NAT per AZ (no cross-AZ dependency).

data.label: exam-platform-prod-api (ENI AZ-A)
data.notes: Exam/assignment REST API: create & schedule exams, start attempt, 30 s autosave (PUT /api/attempts/{id}/answers), submit, mark, release, presigned upload URLs. One DB connection per instance.

data.label: Workers: marking / upload / migrate (ENI AZ-A)
data.notes: marking: auto-marks MCQs from the marking queue + EventBridge auto-submit (max concurrency 20). upload: records submissions from S3 events. migrate: applies schema.sql on deploy.

data.label: exam-platform-prod-api (ENI AZ-B)
data.notes: Same function as AZ-A; Lambda spreads instances over both app subnets, so losing an AZ only removes capacity.

data.label: exam-platform-prod-db PRIMARY (PostgreSQL 16, us-east-1a)
data.notes: Multi-AZ: synchronous standby in AZ-B, automatic failover (~1-2 min, RPO ~0). Not publicly accessible, KMS-encrypted, rds.force_ssl = 1, PITR backups.

customConfig.note: AWS Free plan maximum; PITR still gives ~5 min RPO

data.label: exam-platform-prod-db STANDBY (synchronous, us-east-1b)
data.notes: Synchronous standby replica. Not readable; promoted automatically if AZ-A or the primary fails. Same DNS endpoint after failover.

data.label: exam-platform-prod-public-rt -> IGW
data.notes: Associated with both public subnets. 0.0.0.0/0 -> igw.

data.label: exam-platform-prod-private-rt-us-east-1a -> NAT A
data.notes: Associated with app + data subnets in AZ-A. 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-a; S3 prefix list -> S3 gateway endpoint. No IGW route.

data.label: exam-platform-prod-private-rt-us-east-1b -> NAT B
data.notes: Associated with app + data subnets in AZ-B. 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-b; S3 prefix list -> S3 gateway endpoint. No IGW route.

data.label: CloudFront distribution (HTTPS, 2 origins)
data.notes: Default behaviour -> S3 web bucket (cached SPA, OAC). /api/* -> API Gateway (no cache, auth header forwarded).

data.label: exam-platform-prod-admin (no VPC)
data.notes: /api/admin/* - manages Cognito users and groups. Outside the VPC because it never touches the database.

customConfig.lifecycle: IA 30 d -> Glacier IR 180 d -> Deep Archive 365 d -> delete 1825 d

data.label: exam-platform-prod-notify (no VPC)
data.notes: Sends emails through SES. Outside the VPC (no DB access); max concurrency 5 to stay under the SES send rate.
